decisions.statement: A page's camel keys become the kebab spelling every reader below this module uses.
A key already kebab is unchanged.
Kebabising a kebab key answers the same key.
A slug and a page type come off the file name only where the body states no slug and no page type.
A page whose body will not load answers with nothing rather than with an empty page.
The values a page keeps outside the commit are put back before any value is read.
An entry property is left as its declaration says.
The rows beside a page are found.
An akasha page and a markdown page are one population.

definition: the values an akasha page declares, in the shape the query engine reads a markdown page in
